title: Отчётные глаголы: suggest, recommend, deny, admit, accuse + конструкции

why: Отчётные глаголы (suggest, recommend, deny, admit, accuse) передают не просто слова, а намерение говорящего: совет, признание, отрицание, обвинение. По-русски мы говорим «предложил пойти», «признал, что ошибся», «обвинил в краже». В английском смысл тот же, но после каждого глагола стоит своя конструкция, и угадывать её нельзя — её нужно выучить вместе с глаголом.
formation: • suggest / recommend + V-ing: He suggested going by train.
• suggest / recommend / admit / deny + (that) + подлежащее + глагол: She admitted that she was wrong.
• suggest / recommend + that + кто-то + базовая форма глагола (или should + глагол): I suggest that he call the client. / I suggest that he should call the client.
• admit / deny + V-ing; для действия в прошлом можно having + V3: He denied breaking the server. / He denied having broken the server.
• accuse + кого-то + of + V-ing: They accused him of stealing data.
• advise (а не recommend) + кому-то + to + глагол: She advised me to wait.
usage: 1. Предложение и совет (suggest, recommend): I recommend using Git. (Я рекомендую использовать Git.) They suggested that we meet at six. (Они предложили встретиться в шесть.)
2. Признание (admit): He admitted forgetting the password. (Он признался, что забыл пароль.)
3. Отрицание (deny): She denied that she had seen the message. (Она отрицала, что видела сообщение.)
4. Обвинение (accuse): The boss accused Tom of lying. (Босс обвинил Тома во лжи.)
signalWords: after suggest / recommend / admit / deny всегда смотрим на следующее слово: либо V-ing, либо that. Предлог of бывает только после accuse somebody.
mistakes: ✗ She suggested me to leave → ✓ She suggested that I leave / She suggested leaving. После suggest нет «кому-то + to + глагол».
✗ He denied to take the money → ✓ He denied taking the money. После deny только V-ing или that.
✗ They accused him for cheating → ✓ They accused him of cheating. Accuse всегда с of, а не for.
✗ I recommend to use this library → ✓ I recommend using this library. После recommend нет to + глагол сразу.
✗ He accused me to be late → ✓ He accused me of being late. После of нужен V-ing.
remember: suggest, recommend, admit, deny — это V-ing или that; accuse — всегда of + V-ing; to + глагол после suggest не бывает.

items.prompt: She suggested ___ (take) a taxi.
items.answer: taking

items.prompt: He denied ___ (steal) the money.
items.answer: stealing

items.prompt: I recommend ___ (read) this book.
items.answer: reading

items.prompt: Tom admitted ___ (make) a mistake in the code.
items.answer: making / having made

items.prompt: Anna suggested ___ (have) lunch together.
items.answer: having

items.prompt: The doctor recommended ___ (drink) more water.
items.answer: drinking

items.prompt: They denied ___ (know) about the problem.
items.answer: knowing / having known

items.prompt: He admitted ___ (forget) the password.
items.answer: forgetting / having forgotten

items.prompt: He suggested (a) to go (b) going (c) go to the cinema.
items.answer: (b) going

items.prompt: I recommend (a) that you see (b) you to see (c) you seeing a doctor.
items.answer: (a) that you see

items.prompt: They accused him (a) for (b) of (c) in stealing the idea.
items.answer: (b) of

items.prompt: She denied (a) that she had seen (b) to see (c) she see him.
items.answer: (a) that she had seen

items.prompt: He suggested that we (a) to meet (b) meeting (c) meet at six.
items.answer: (c) meet

items.prompt: The manager accused the team (a) of missing (b) to miss (c) missing the deadline.
items.answer: (a) of missing

items.prompt: He admitted (a) that he was (b) him being (c) to be late.
items.answer: (a) that he was

items.prompt: I'd recommend (a) to stay (b) staying (c) stay at this hotel.
items.answer: (b) staying

items.prompt: 'Let's go to the park,' said Mia. (suggested)
items.answer: Mia suggested going to the park. / Mia suggested that we go to the park.

items.prompt: 'I didn't take your laptop,' Dan told me. (denied)
items.answer: Dan denied taking my laptop. / Dan denied that he had taken my laptop. / Dan denied having taken my laptop.

items.prompt: 'Yes, I deleted the file,' said Kate. (admitted)
items.answer: Kate admitted deleting the file. / Kate admitted having deleted the file. / Kate admitted that she had deleted the file.

items.prompt: 'You stole my idea!' Paul said to Ben. (accused)
items.answer: Paul accused Ben of stealing his idea.

items.prompt: 'You should try this tool,' she said to us. (recommended)
items.answer: She recommended trying this tool. / She recommended that we try this tool. / She recommended that we should try this tool.

items.prompt: 'Why don't we call the client?' said Max. (suggested)
items.answer: Max suggested calling the client. / Max suggested that we call the client.

items.prompt: 'I didn't see the message,' said Lena. (denied)
items.answer: Lena denied seeing the message. / Lena denied having seen the message. / Lena denied that she had seen the message.

items.prompt: 'You lied to the customers,' the boss said to Tom. (accused)
items.answer: The boss accused Tom of lying to the customers.

items.prompt: She suggested to go to the cinema.
items.answer: She suggested going to the cinema. / She suggested that we go to the cinema.

items.prompt: He denied to take the money.
items.answer: He denied taking the money.

items.prompt: They accused him for cheating.
items.answer: They accused him of cheating.

items.prompt: I recommend to use this library.
items.answer: I recommend using this library.

items.prompt: He admitted to make a serious mistake.
items.answer: He admitted making a serious mistake. / He admitted to making a serious mistake.

items.prompt: The doctor suggested me to rest.
items.answer: The doctor suggested that I rest. / The doctor suggested resting.

items.prompt: He accused me to be late.
items.answer: He accused me of being late.

items.prompt: I suggest you to check the logs.
items.answer: I suggest (that) you check the logs. / I suggest checking the logs. / I suggest that you should check the logs.

items.prompt: Я предложил встретиться в пятницу.
items.answer: I suggested meeting on Friday. / I suggested that we meet on Friday.

items.prompt: Он признал, что допустил ошибку в коде.
items.answer: He admitted that he had made a mistake in the code. / He admitted making a mistake in the code.

items.prompt: Она отрицает, что видела это письмо.
items.answer: She denies seeing this email. / She denies that she saw this email.

items.prompt: Врач порекомендовал мне больше отдыхать.
items.answer: The doctor recommended that I rest more. / The doctor recommended resting more.

items.prompt: Клиент обвинил нас в том, что мы потеряли данные.
items.answer: The client accused us of losing the data.

items.prompt: Я бы порекомендовал использовать React для этого проекта.
items.answer: I would recommend using React for this project. / I'd recommend using React for this project.

items.prompt: Они предложили поехать в отпуск в сентябре.
items.answer: They suggested going on vacation in September. / They suggested that we go on vacation in September.

items.prompt: Том признался, что забыл про встречу.
items.answer: Tom admitted that he had forgotten about the meeting. / Tom admitted forgetting about the meeting.
